_comment: Ship upgrades sold at station outfitting modules (AOutfittingModule and its specialist workshops). Loaded at startup by UShipUpgradeCatalogSubsystem. category: Engines|Weapons|Shields|Hull|Cargo (EShipUpgradeCategory). tier 1-5: a module fits up to its max tier (general Outfitting Bay 2, specialist workshops 3, +1 per station-editor upgrade level). cost: list price in credits; selling back refunds half. maxStack: how many can be fitted (each takes a slot of the category; 1 = unique). stats: stat is one of MaxSpeed, Acceleration, BoostMultiplier, HullStrength, ShieldStrength, CargoCapacity, WeaponDamage (multiplier, base 1), MiningPower; value = (base + sum of add) * product of mult over every fitted stack. Optional: requires / exclusiveWith (lists of upgrade ids).

Upgrades.name: Thruster Tune-Up
Upgrades.description: Re-timed injector pulses and cleaned nozzles. A little more of everything.

Upgrades.name: Afterburner Coil
Upgrades.description: Dumps extra plasma into the exhaust while boosting.

Upgrades.name: Ion Injectors
Upgrades.description: Ionised propellant feed for a higher sustained top speed.

Upgrades.name: Fusion Drive Core
Upgrades.description: A compact fusion torch replacing the stock drive core.

Upgrades.name: Overdrive Manifold
Upgrades.description: Racing-grade manifold. Enormous boost at the cost of the afterburner hardpoint.

Upgrades.name: Beam Focusing Lens
Upgrades.description: Tighter beam on the nose hardpoint: the mining laser cuts faster.

Upgrades.name: Fire-Control Suite
Upgrades.description: Lead-computing targeting for every hardpoint.

Upgrades.name: Excavator Emitter
Upgrades.description: Industrial emitter head. Rips ore out of rock.

Upgrades.name: Capacitor Bank
Upgrades.description: Stores charge between shots for heavier hits.

Upgrades.name: Plasma Accelerator
Upgrades.description: Magnetic accelerator rails for every weapon mount.

Upgrades.name: Quantum Coupler
Upgrades.description: Couples every emitter to the reactor directly.

Upgrades.name: Shield Capacitor
Upgrades.description: Extra capacitor cells for the shield generator.

Upgrades.name: Harmonic Emitter
Upgrades.description: Tuned emitters spread load evenly across the bubble.

Upgrades.name: Lattice Projector
Upgrades.description: Layered lattice field, military pattern.

Upgrades.name: Aegis Matrix
Upgrades.description: Capital-ship shield matrix squeezed into a hull slot.

Upgrades.name: Reinforced Plating
Upgrades.description: Bolted-on steel plate over the weak points.

Upgrades.name: Composite Armour
Upgrades.description: Ceramic-alloy composite panels.

Upgrades.name: Ablative Armour
Upgrades.description: Thick ablative layers. Tough, but heavy.

Upgrades.name: Neutronium Weave
Upgrades.description: Exotic-matter weave through the frame.

Upgrades.name: Extended Cargo Racks
Upgrades.description: Fold-out racks along the hold walls.

Upgrades.name: Hold Expansion
Upgrades.description: Moves bulkheads to enlarge the hold.

Upgrades.name: Compression Racks
Upgrades.description: Pressurised racks pack goods far tighter. The extra mass slows the ship.

Upgrades.name: Subspace Pocket Hold
Upgrades.description: A hold that is larger on the inside.
